items.headline: Hormuz me teen tanker mine se aag
items.detail: Iran ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me teen tel tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me ghire; Iran ka daava hai jahaz pratibandhit kshetra me the, swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz: vishwa tel vyapar ka mahatvapurna jaladmarumadhya.

items.headline: Jeffries pehle Black Speaker ke ummidvar
items.detail: House Democrats ne band matdan me 251-11 se Hakeem Jeffries ko Speaker pad ke liye namankit kiya; 3 January ko poore House me matdan hoga, jeetne par ve pehle Black Speaker banenge.
items.exam_angle: America ke House Speaker: rashtrapati uttaradhikar me teesra sthan.
items.image_credit: Office of Representative Hakeem Jeffries, Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: 2035 tak Islam sabse bada dharm
items.detail: Pew Research ke anuman ke mutabik 2035 tak Musalman aabadi 2.57 arab hokar Isaiyon (2.52 arab) se aage nikal jayegi; unchi janm dar is badlav ki mukhya vajah hai.
items.exam_angle: Pew Global Religious Futures: jansankhya aur dharm ka adhyayan.

items.headline: Israel ka Gaza me naya bhumi abhiyan
items.detail: Israel ne October 2025 yuddhaviram ke baad pehli baar madhya Gaza me Yellow Line ke paschim me bhumi karvai shuru ki; Bureij-Nuseirat ke logon ko ilaka khali karne ko kaha gaya.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram (Oct 2025) aur Board of Peace ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Bangladesh ka pehla parmanu sanyantra grid se juda
items.detail: Bangladesh ke Rooppur parmanu sanyantra ki pehli ikai ne 17 November ko parikshan ke roop me 350 MW bijli rashtriya grid ko di; poori kshamata 1,200 MW hai aur vanijyik utpadan 10 mahine ke parikshan ke baad shuru hoga.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ka pehla parmanu sanyantra; Russia ki Rosatom ne banaya.

items.headline: Kumamoto me 5.7 ka bhukamp
items.detail: Japan ke Kumamoto prant me subah 5.7 teevrata ka bhukamp aaya; koi sunami chetavni nahi, ek hafte tak tez jhatko ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan: Ring of Fire par sthit, bhukamp-prone desh.

items.headline: Crimean Bridge par hafte me teesra hamla
items.detail: Crimea ke governor ke anusar is hafte teesri baar Crimean Bridge par hamle ke baad yatayat roka gaya; nuksan ka aaklan chal raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge: Russia-Crimea ko jodne wala 19 km lamba pul.

items.headline: Anthropic ka $83 IPO, sabse bada tech listing
items.detail: AI company Anthropic ne apna IPO $83 prati share par tay kiya; 980 million share se $81.3 arab juta — ab tak ka sabse bada tech IPO, aaj Nasdaq par ANT ticker se trading shuru hogi.
items.exam_angle: IPO aur AI company ka pehla bada public listing — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Iran ne Kuwait-Bahrain me US thikano par hamla
items.detail: Iran ke drone ne Kuwait ke Ali Al-Salem air base aur Bahrain me US sainya thikano ko nishana banaya; dono deshon ne hamle roke, koi nuksan ya hatahat ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me US sainya adde aur America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Uttar Korea ne Yongbyon samvardhan sanyantra badhaya
items.detail: IAEA pramukh Grossi ne kaha Uttar Korea ne Yongbyon parmanu parisar me uranium samvardhan sanyantra ka aur vistaar kar liya hai; vistaar October ke ant tak bahari roop se poora ho gaya tha.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea ka parmanu karyakram aur IAEA ki bhoomika — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
